correctness.rationale: Exact polynomial-row recursion and Vandermonde evaluation give the Gramian determinant with exponent m(m+1). Strict interior positivity and inverse price-weight ordering follow from homogeneity and swap-and-rescale. The strictly negative-definite log objective makes the chamber maximizer unique, and its multiplier d/B follows by Euler homogeneity. Standard Laguerre ODE, root sum/product and resultant/discriminant identities yield the equal-cost formula. Standalone exact rational determinants m=1..6 and Laguerre discriminants m=2..7 and explicit two-spoke optimality tests support but do not replace universal proof.

value.rationale: For all star sizes and all positive costs, a natural controllability-volume optimization admits exact structural ordering, unique global optimization without combinatorial assignment search, and an explicit equal-cost orthogonal-polynomial formula and exact objective value. It is substantially more informative than checking generic controllability rank or naming Laguerre roots.
